mustum.definition: mustum ī, n fresh grape-juice, unfermented wine, must: dulce, V., Iu.—Plur, vintages, autumns: ter centum musta videre, O.—Fig.: quasi de musto ac lacu fervida oratio, i. e. still in ferment.

mutabilitas.definition: mūtābilitās ātis, f mutabilis, changeableness, mutability : mentis.

mutatus.definition: mūtātus adj. P. of muto, different, successive : medicamina, Iu.

mutuatio.definition: mūtuātiō ōnis, f mutuor, a borrowing .

mutue.definition: mūtuē adv. mutuus, mutually, in return : responderi.

myoparo.definition: myoparō ōnis, m , muopa/rwn, a small warship, privateer: piraticus.

myrica.definition: myrīca ae, f , muri/kh, the tamarisk (a shrub): tenues, O.—Prov.: Pinguia corticibus sudent electra myricae (of an impossibility), V.: laturas poma myricas speret, O.

myrmillo.definition: myrmillō ōnis, m a gladiator, with Gallic arms and a mormyr on the crest, C., Iu.

myrteus.definition: myrteus (murteus) adj. myrtus, of myrtles, myrtle- : silva, V.: coma, myrtle-colored , i. e. chestnut-brown , Tb.

myrtum.definition: myrtum (mur-) ī, n , mu/rton, the fruit of the myrtle, myrtle-berry: cruenta myrta, V.

myrtus.definition: myrtus (mur-) ī (plur nom. ūs, V.), f , mu/rtos, a myrtle, myrtle-tree: viridis, H.: bicolor (i. e. with berries red and black), O.—A spear of myrtle-wood: pastoralis, V.

mystagogus.definition: mystagōgus ī, m , mustogwgo/s, a guide to mysteries, verger, valet de place.

mysticus.definition: mysticus adj. , mustiko/s, of secret rites, mystic, mystical: vannus Iacchi, V.
